desc:
🎶 Over 1500+ Karaoke songs! 🎶

🏆 Compete against other players to get the highest Karaoke rating! 🏆

📣 Earn cheers to unlock particles, winner emotes and more! 📣

🥇 Rank on the Karaoke leaderboards! 🥇

💎 Premium users earn 2x cheers by default (in-game Karaoke currency)💎

💰 Donations use gamepasses and can take up to a week to receive. The amount will be less than the amount shown in-game due to Roblox taxes. You can view your pending Robux in your transactions tab 💰

badges.name: Complete a Round
badges.desc: Complete 1 whole round, which contains 10 songs!

badges.name: Sing a Song
badges.desc: You sung your first song! Hopefully you had lots of people cheering for you!

badges.name: Donated
badges.desc: Thanks for donating to another player! I'm sure you made their day with your generosity!

badges.name: Meet The Creator!
badges.desc: You met Zerophyx, thanks for playing our game!

badges.name: Earned a Donation
badges.desc: Someone donated to you! You must've really resonated with them!

badges.name: First Place
badges.desc: You earned your very first gold medal! Great job, I'm sure there will be many more where that came from!

badges.name: Second Place
badges.desc: Second place is still great! I'm sure you'll hit first place next time! (If you haven't already)

badges.name: Third Place
badges.desc: Third place is still in the top three so congratulations!

badges.name: Play For 1 Hour
badges.desc: You've played the game for an hour, thanks for the support!

badges.name: Play For 12 Hours
badges.desc: 12 hours? I really hope you're enjoying your stay with us!

badges.name: Play For 24 Hours
badges.desc: You've played for a total of 24 hours now. I'm sure everyone knows of you by now! Thank you for playing the game!

badges.name: Play For 48 Hours
badges.desc: Two whole days, 48 hours. By now, you've reached the status of a super star. When people join the game, they're probably not surprised to see you there! :)

badges.name: Meet The Owner!
badges.desc: Wow, you just met AlsoBunni, lucky you!
